PDF COS 426 Final Project Writeup Raymarching with Signed Distance Fields
Abstract We explore an alternative technique to raytracing for rendering 3D scenes called signed distance field raymarching that represents the entire scene using a sign distance field (SDF) that maps each point in space to the distance to the nearest object.
